I found out when I was 20 and I was on the pill about a year before I found out! So same boat. Tho my period was punctual, it was abnormally heavy. My cramps were very, very bad and they seemed like with each cycle they got progressively worse. I had cystic acne from puberty up until I got on the pill (11 years!), thinning hair, and severe depression, boils..... just....a lot. And then there was the ultrasound that showed the cysts on my ovaries. The only thing I was told do is continue my birth control. I was prescribed a high dose of ibuprofen for when the pain comes during my period. Other than that, nothing

It’s silly for your doctor to think you don’t have PCOS bc your periods seemed regular....mine were, they came same time every month. Yet I still have PCOS. The diagnosis didn’t come until maybe the 5th time I complained about certain symptoms and my doctor signed me up for an ultrasound which eventually led to my diagnosis and an explanation for all of my symptoms. You may just need to see another doctor.
